# scm_dlp_data_pattern_list (Data Source)

Lists Enterprise DLP Data Patterns with optional name filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List DLP data patterns, optionally filtered by name.
data "scm_dlp_data_pattern_list" "all" {}

data "scm_dlp_data_pattern_list" "by_name" {
  name = "REPLACE_WITH_NAME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter data patterns by name.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of matching data patterns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total` (Number) Total number of data patterns matching query.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A description of the data pattern.
- `detection_config` (Attributes) Detection technique configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--detection_config))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data pattern.
- `matching_rules` (Attributes) Matching rules for regex and weighted_regex techniques. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--matching_rules))
- `name` (String) The name of the data pattern.
- `status` (String) The status of the data pattern.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `type` (String) The type of data pattern.
- `version` (Number) The version of the data pattern.

<a id="nestedatt--data--detection_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.detection_config`

Read-Only:

- `supported_confidence_levels` (List of String) Supported confidence levels.
- `technique` (String) Detection technique.


<a id="nestedatt--data--matching_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.matching_rules`

Read-Only:

- `proximity_distance` (Number) Proximity distance for keywords.
- `proximity_keywords` (List of String) List of proximity keywords.
- `regexes` (Attributes List) List of regex rules with weights. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--matching_rules--regexes))

<a id="nestedatt--data--matching_rules--regexes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.matching_rules.regexes`

Read-Only:

- `weight` (Number) Weight for the regular expression match.
